additional_info.subject: ID0455629-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / P0 312569868/01] Payment Host Unreachable CRM:03055000114
additional_info.body:
Dear Nicolas Raymond,
Thank you for reaching out regarding the Payment Host Unreachable issue with your Sicharge D Charging Center.
Based on similar cases, this error flag can be caused by network-related issues such as a defective or disconnected network cable, a faulty network switch, or power supply problems with the payment terminal. It is also important to verify that the IP address configuration of the payment terminal is correct. For example, the payment terminal should have a static IP address, subnet mask, gateway, and DNS settings properly configured. Additionally, ensuring all connections are secure and swapping the Ethernet cable with a new one can help identify if the cable is the source of the problem. The Ethernet connection should be set up as follows: Payment terminal connected to Switch, which is then connected to Router 2
1
.
->
As we checked the Error Logs on our side, it seems the error is not present anymore. I will continue to monitor the charger for 3 days. If the error does not come back, I will proceed to close the ticket.
Please check these aspects to help resolve the Payment Host Unreachable error. If you need further assistance, feel free to contact me.
Regards,
eMobility Technical Support Team-
Calin Ienei
